zh.title: ATR分析印尼具209條潛在航線 預估年客運量達1600萬人次
zh.summary: ATR指出印尼有209條潛在國內航線，年客運潛力達1600萬人次。
body: 區域渦輪螺旋槳飛機製造商 ATR 發布研究報告指出，印尼國內市場有高達 209 條全新航線具備經濟可行性。該公司指出，儘管現有的機場基礎設施已經存在，但印尼仍有約 1,600 萬人次的年度客運市場基本上尚未被開發。

根據 ATR 的分析資料，印尼全境 180 個鋪設跑道的機場中，目前有 70 個完全沒有任何定期客運服務，這為開闢全新國內航線提供了巨大空間，且不需要進行大規模的基礎設施投資。這項發現來自 ATR 的 MobilityMonitor 平台，該平台追蹤了 3,500 萬名印尼居民的旅行模式。資料顯示，該群體在一年內進行了約 7.8 億次城際旅行，其中約 90% 的旅程距離在 100 至 800 公里之間，非常適合渦輪螺旋槳飛機運營。

在這 209 條潛在航線中，約有 88%（代表每年約 1,400 萬名旅客）屬於島內連接，而非跨島航線。此外，高達 90% 的潛在航線位於爪哇島（Java）以外的地區，包括蘇門答臘（Sumatra）、蘇拉威西（Sulawesi）、加里曼丹（Kalimantan）、巴布亞（Papua）和馬魯古（Maluku）。這反映出印尼基礎設施的不均衡：爪哇島僅佔全國土地面積的 7%，卻擁有約 58% 的公路網；而加里曼丹面積是爪哇島的四倍，卻僅佔有 5% 的高速公路。
這種基礎設施差距嚴重影響了當地的交通移動效率。在爪哇島，平均地面行車時速可達 65 公里，但在其他群島地區則降至每小時 26 至 37 公里。ATR 將蘇門答臘和蘇拉威西列為區域航空的最大潛在市場。以蘇門答臘的奔古魯（BKS）至北干巴魯（PKU）航線為例，地面公路旅行需要花費 18 小時以上，而直飛航班僅需約 1 小時。ATR 估計，該航線的需求可支持每日 2 班航班。
ATR 商業部門高級副總裁 Alexis Vidal 表示，資料顯示出一個龐大且基本上尚未開發的市場，目前印尼當地的需求和機場基礎設施均已具備，所需要的是合適的飛機。他補充指出，透過區域航空服務連結各個島嶼社區，將有助於推動經濟增長、提供更多基本服務的獲取管道，並為民眾創造更多機會。

en.title: ATR Identifies 209 Potential New Domestic Routes with 16 Million Passenger Market in Indonesia
en.summary: ATR identifies 209 viable new domestic air routes representing 16 million annual passengers across Indonesia.
body: Franco-Italian turboprop aircraft manufacturer ATR has identified 209 new domestic air routes across Indonesia that could be economically viable using regional turboprop aircraft. The manufacturer points to an untapped annual market of roughly 16 million passengers, which exists despite the presence of operational airport infrastructure.

According to ATR's findings, 70 of Indonesia’s 180 airports with paved runways currently have no scheduled passenger services. This indicates significant potential for new domestic connections without requiring major investments in airport infrastructure. The results were obtained from ATR’s MobilityMonitor platform, which analyzed the travel habits of 35 million Indonesian residents who completed about 780 million inter-city trips in a year.

The platform's findings indicate that approximately 90% of those inter-city journeys fell between 100 and 800 kilometers, a distance range well suited for turboprop operations. Furthermore, 88% of the identified potential routes, representing 14 million passengers annually, are intra-island connections rather than inter-island links. About 90% of these routes are located on islands other than Java, including Sumatra, Sulawesi, Kalimantan, Papua, and Maluku.

This geographical distribution highlights Indonesia's infrastructure disparities. While Java covers only 7% of the land area, it contains 58% of the country’s motorway network, allowing surface travel speeds to reach 65 kilometers per hour. In contrast, Kalimantan is four times larger than Java but has only 5% of the motorways, with surface speeds on outer islands dropping to between 26 and 37 kilometers per hour.

ATR identified Sumatra and Sulawesi as the most promising markets for regional air service development. For instance, traveling by road between Bengkulu (BKS (BKS)) and Pekanbaru (PKU (PKU)) in Sumatra takes more than 18 hours, whereas a direct flight would take approximately one hour. ATR estimates this route could support two daily flights. Alexis Vidal, ATR’s Senior Vice-President, Commercial, noted that both demand and airport infrastructure are present, and the market now requires appropriate aircraft to bridge these mobility gaps.

zh.title: 首批兩架F-16V blk70戰機美國起飛 預計近期飛抵台灣
zh.summary: 首批兩架F-16V戰機已自美國起飛；途中實施空中加油與整備；預計近期飛抵台灣
body: 台灣向美國採購的66架全新F-16V（blk70）戰機中，首批2架（機號為6727與6728）已於美東時間17日自美國起飛。為因應跨太平洋長途飛行的體能負荷與航程規劃，戰機在飛行途中將進行空中加油並停留整備，預計近期飛抵台灣。
此批新機屬於國軍代號「鳳翔專案」的採購計畫，總計編列新台幣2472億2883萬元持續性預算。雖然原規劃於今年全數返台，但因美方生產線搬遷重啟及供應鏈中斷等因素影響而稍微延宕，目前美方已採取雙班制每日20小時趕工交機。
此外，空軍先前透過「鳳展專案」，由美國洛克希德馬丁與漢翔公司合作，將現役140架F-16A/B戰機升級為F-16V（blk20），該升級案已於112年12月全數完成。

en.title: First Two F-16V blk70 Fighters Depart US for Taiwan Delivery
en.summary: Two F-16V blk70 fighters departed the US for Taiwan; midair refueling and technical stops are planned.
body: The first two F-16V blk70 fighter aircraft, numbered 6727 and 6728, departed the United States on August 17 US Eastern Time heading for Taiwan. To manage crew physical strain and flight planning for the transpacific route, the aircraft will undergo midair refueling and technical maintenance stops along the way before arriving in Taiwan.

The delivery is part of Taiwan's procurement program for 66 new F-16V blk70 fighters under a continuous budget of 247.23 billion New Taiwan dollars. Although initial plans called for all aircraft to be delivered within this year, deliveries were delayed due to factory relocation and supply chain disruptions. US production is operating two shifts to expedite work.
Separately, an earlier upgrade project involving Lockheed Martin and AIDC converted 140 existing F-16A/B aircraft to the F-16V blk20 standard, which was completed in December 2023.

zh.title: 法國航空將空中巴士A318退役推遲至2027年3月
zh.summary: 法航將A318退役延至2027年3月；保留精品艙131座
body: 根據Simple Flying的報導，法國航空決定將原本預定較早退役的空中巴士A318機隊，延後四個月至2027年3月才全數退役。
該機型將繼續執飛精選城市短程航線，並保留精品艙配置與131座布局，維持旅客舒適體驗。
早先同樣來源指出，法航A318最後階段將覆蓋13個國家、37條航線，顯示機隊退役前仍具廣泛營運範圍。
這項延後意味著旅客仍可在未來半年內搭乘A318體驗獨特艙位。法航亦維持該機型的高載客率與靈活調度。

en.title: Air France pushes final Airbus A318 retirement to March 2027
en.summary: Air France delays A318 retirement to March 2027; retains boutique 131‑seat cabin
body: According to Simple Flying, Air France has postponed the final retirement of its Airbus A318 fleet by four months, now targeting March 2027 for complete withdrawal.
The aircraft will continue to operate selected short‑haul city routes and retain a boutique cabin layout with 131 seats, preserving the passenger experience.
An earlier Simple Flying report noted that the A318’s final phase covered 13 countries and 37 routes, indicating a broad operational footprint before retirement.
The delay means travelers can still fly the A318 for roughly another half‑year, and Air France maintains the type’s high load factor and flexible scheduling.
